title: Development of a green spectrofluorimetric method for mefenamic acid determination using Rhodamine 6G with mechanistic investigation and central composite design optimization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34781-34796
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05667E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Arwa Sultan Alqahtani, Maram H. Abduljabbar, Reem M. Alnemari, Saleh I. Alaqel, Ahmed Serag, Atiah H. Almalki
A green spectrofluorimetric method for mefenamic acid determination using Rhodamine 6G was developed with central composite design optimization, achieving superior sensitivity and environmental sustainability compared to conventional methods.
